title: Crude sheen over Heera field
description: A 4.8 km² crude oil slick was detected over the Mumbai High Heera field. Backward drift places the origin on the Vadinar-bound tanker lane and the top-ranked tanker shows a 38-minute AIS gap with a 5.9 kt speed drop.

title: Sheen near Neelam approach
description: A 3.1 km² sheen was detected on the Neelam field approach. Attribution is split between a product tanker and a bulk carrier transiting the corridor.
